title: Selected Work
subtitle: A Claude Project + Claude Skill shipped, a Copilot skill introduced team by team, and vibe-coding onboarding co-defined with founders — selected for Lovehoney

bio.short: I'm Tobias Treppmann, a design leader in Berlin working closer to the model than to the screen. Fifteen-plus years across four Head- and Director-of-design tenures, most recently at Bibel TV — where an AI fundraising ecosystem I built solo runs on a Claude Project with follow-up-question loops and a Claude Skill that carries the same voice into in-app notifications, web banners, and video scripts. I run a personal twelve-agent MCP-configured stack as daily practice, and I've been facilitating workshops for non-designer, non-engineer audiences — HR, marketing, service teams — since Hypoport.
bio.long:
I'm Tobias Treppmann, a design leader based in Berlin, and lately my work sits closer to the model than to the screen. At Bibel TV I built a fundraising ecosystem end to end — analysed which letters historically outperform, encoded the analysis into a Claude Project that asks follow-up questions before it drafts anything, built a web prototype for the generation flow, and shipped a Claude Skill that produces the follow-up notifications, web banners, and video scripts from the same source. All of it solo, at the layer where prompt design and product design stop being separable. I also designed, scoped, and shipped a Copilot skill for the customer-support team, introduced through a self-testing week and 1:1 sessions with each team member; adoption held across the seniority-and-scepticism spectrum, including the initially most sceptical person on the team.

Before Bibel TV I spent a year at ChurchDesk mapping a funeral-coordination process that ran on phone calls between funeral homes, parishes, and cemeteries. I reframed it from a booking feature into a booking capability wired deep into the platform. Days of phone-tag became hours; the acceptance rate landed at ninety percent; twenty-plus cemeteries came on board. At Ninox I co-defined the vibe-coding onboarding with the CEO and technical co-founder in a stealth pre-product-team phase — prompt to database schema, rendered into the real data-model editor with direct manipulation and chat side by side, so a non-technical SME owner can own the schema within minutes of seeing it. In parallel I ran the design system as a structured cross-functional group: one design lead assigned, one engineer assigned, regular meeting rhythm, documented process for identifying component changes and escalating them.

What runs underneath all of that is a personal practice with the same tools this role customises for Lovehoney. Claude Skills, Claude Projects, Claude Code, Claude Co-work, Microsoft Copilot, and a twelve-agent MCP-configured stack I self-host and use every day. I've been running the "Designing with and for AI" workshop series for designers and engineers since 2024 — and at Hypoport Hub SE I ran design-thinking training programs for executive leadership plus service teams that included HR, marketing, and other non-designer, non-engineer functions. I'm plain-spoken, comfortable in sensitive-context work (ChurchDesk was GDPR-plus across six countries), and Berlin is home.

context.company: Lovehoney Group — UK-owned adult retail group, 800+ employees across 11 offices, Bain-Capital-backed. Berlin office. Category is adult-wellness / sexual-wellbeing e-commerce.
context.role: AI Innovation and Enablement Specialist — an internal-tooling operator role, IC-shaped despite Specialist title. Owns the Claude Enterprise rollout function by function across the group, runs a Champions Programme of internal AI advocates, customises Claude Skills / Claude Projects / Claude Code / MCP servers, facilitates workshops for both technical and non-technical audiences, and maps process inefficiencies into automations.

selection_rationale.bibeltv-ai-fundraising: Featured #1. THE flagship 'Claude Project + Claude Skill in production' story — near-1:1 match to the JD's 'customising Claude Projects and Claude Skills to meet team and business needs.' Analysis → Claude Project with follow-up-question loops → web prototype → Claude Skill producing follow-up content across three surfaces (in-app notifications, web banners, video scripts). All solo, at the prompt-and-context layer. In-depth format because the four-artefact ecosystem + design decisions compress badly at executive altitude. Screenshots + performance-data confidentiality gaps carried in asset_gaps_blocking_publication.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-support-agent: Featured #2. THE flagship enablement-of-a-non-technical-team story. Designed / scoped / shipped an MS Copilot skill for the Bibel TV customer-support team; introduced through a self-testing week followed by 1:1 sessions with each team member; qualitative adoption across the seniority-and-scepticism spectrum, including the initially most sceptical person on the team. This is the champions-in-miniature playbook — the closest single artefact in the portfolio to Lovehoney's 'sustain a network of internal AI advocates.' Honest scope: MS Copilot configured skill, not a custom-built agent (truthfulness rule #1). In-depth format because the human-in-the-loop + escalation-as-first-class-output + handbook-as-context design decisions are what make it credible.
selection_rationale.ninox-ai-onboarding: Featured #3. Second AI proof + the Champions-Programme-adjacent structural precedent surfaces here through the case study's related work (ninox-org-building) and through the case study's founder-team collaboration story. Vibe-coding split-screen direct manipulation co-defined with the CEO and technical co-founder in stealth pre-product-team phase — real dual-path workflow design (chat + direct manipulation coexist; first-schema-is-wrong handled as normal case; user-agency principle 'show output, allow users to edit'). Fully illustrated (5 images on disk). In-depth format.
selection_rationale.churchdesk-booking-system: Browseable #1. THE flagship process-mapping / inefficiency-identification story for JD Must-Have #7. Mapped the phone-based funeral coordination process with parishes / funeral homes / cemeteries; reframed from a single feature into a booking capability deeply integrated into the platform. 70% coordination-time reduction (days → hours), 90% booking acceptance rate, 20+ cemeteries, 2-month delivery on €20k budget. Also carries the sensitive-context muscle (Protestant + Catholic data protection frameworks, multi-country DE/DK/UK/SE/NO/CH) as the transferable bridge to Lovehoney's adult-category comfort requirement — without claiming category fluency. Fully illustrated (4 real screenshots on disk). Executive format because the AI angle (production alt-text) is downstream here; the featured trio already carries the AI-primitive signal.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-agentic-engineering: Browseable #2. Agentic-engineering-as-design-method proof for the JD's 'formal or self-taught' technical foundation requirement — Claude Code prototypes with real Bibel TV APIs, engineering consumes prototype code directly, days-to-hours iteration shift, team-wide evangelism of vibe-coded prototyping. Executive format because the two in-depth-heavy Bibel TV slots are spent on the AI-fundraising ecosystem and the CS Copilot. Asset gap: hero + web-prototype images missing on disk (carried in asset_gaps_blocking_publication).
selection_rationale.bibeltv-design-system-api: Browseable #3. Infrastructure-adjacency proof for the technical-foundation requirement — Git-based token repo + Style Dictionary + three-tier hierarchy + automated Web / iOS / Android / Figma sync. Architecturally analogous to MCP as shared context (a useful bridge for a reader whose lens is 'MCP servers as internal infrastructure'). Executive format because the browseable tier's job here is complementary depth, not headline. Fully illustrated.

Surfacing it as featured would muddy the IC-specialist positioning the role reads as. The Champions-Programme-adjacent structural precedent (design system as structured group with named members + meeting rhythm + escalation process) is carried in the CV instead (Ninox bullet per cv-tailoring-notes §Ninox). Available via ?all for readers who go deep on leadership history.
